ORDER 
G. O. (P ) No. 41 70/PD . 

Dated, Trivandrum , 2nd February 1970 . 
Read :-1. G. O. (MS) 100/PD dated 23-3-1967. 

2. G. O. ( P) 88/PD . uated 19-3-1968 

3. G.O. P) 308 /PD dated 8-10-1968 . 
In the G. O. read as second paper above it was 
nrdered that the benefit of permanent exemption from 
passing the obligatory Departmental Tests will be 
available to the personswho attain the age of 50 years 
and who have completed 25 years of service for all 
purposes such as promotion , confirmation etc. 

A doubt has been raised whether the above orders 
are applicable for promotion to all higher posts requir 
ing test qualification irrespective of the fact that they 
are in or outside the regular line of promotion of the 
officer concerned . 

Government have examined thematter and they 
are pleased to clarify that the permanent exemption 
contemplated in the G. 0. second cited will be 
available for promotion to all higher posts requiring 
test qualification irrespective of the fact whether the 
posts are in or outside the regular line of promotion 
of the officer concerned provided that the statutory 
rules if any regulating appointment to such posts 
do not contain any express provision restricting the 
above benefit. 

By order of the Governor , 
G. SUKUMARAN NAIR , 

Deputy Secretary.

NOTIFICATION 
No. 54566/G2/69/AD . 

Dated , Trivandrum , 6 h February 1970 , 
Whereas the Government of Kerala are satisfied 
that Nephantis Serinopa. which is a pest injurious to 
coconut trees is prevalent in certain panchayat areas 
in the Kozhikode District and that immediate pre 
ventive or remedialmeasures have to be taken : 
Now , therefore, in exercise of the 

Pests 
and Diseases Act, 1958 (17 of 1958), the Government 
of Kerala hereby 
(i) declare that " Nephantis Serinopa " is an 

iasect pest of coconut trees; 
(ii) prescribe the following preventive 

remedial measures in respect of the said 

pest, 
(1) cutting and burning of all the affected 

leaves of the coconut trees ; 
(b ) spraying the palms with insecticides pres 

cribe i by the Agriculture Department; 
( c) liberation of parasites supplied by the 

Agriculture Department within thirty 
days from the date of publication of this 

notification in the Gazette 
(iii) define the panchayat areas of Payyoli 

Tikkody,, Moodadi and Thurayur, in 
Kozhikode district as thelocal areas within 
which , and a period of one year from the 
date of publication of this Notification in 
the Gazette as the period during which , 

this notification shall be in force; and 
(iv) declare that it shall be competent to the 

Government to cause the preventive or 
remedialmeasures prescr bed above to be 
carried out in the notified area .

of the Kerala Agricultural Pests and Diseases Act, 
1958 (7 of 1958), the Goverment of Kerala hereby 
appoint the oficers of the Agriculture D.partment not 
below the rank of Agricultural Extension Officer and

ORDER 
G. O. Rt. 2539/69/Health . 

Dated , Trivandrum , 29th December 1969 , 
Read :-1. G. O. Ms. 341 /68 /HD. dated 28-9-1968 . 

2. G. O. Rt. 636 /6 / Tealth dated 25-3-1969. 

In the G. O. read as 2nd paper above, 
Shri N. Sreedharan , Principal, Ayurveda College, 
Trivandrum was put in ad itional charge of the post 
of Director of IndigenousMedicine which fell vacant 
consequent on the retirement of Shri M.N. Ke ava 
Pillai. The above arrangement has been continuing 
for the last few months. It is found that there is pra 
ctical difficulty in continuing the present arrangement, 
From experience , it is noticed that there is delay in 
getting replies to the references issued by Government 
from the office of the Director of Indigenous Medicine . 
This is due to the fact that the Principal, Ayurveda 
College, Trivandrum is unable to devote proper atten. 
tion and time to the work both in the College office 
and in the offic of the Director of Indigenous Medi 
cine. Further, the Principal has also been assigned 
teaching work in the College and other functions such 
as Examinership, etc. Mercover , the present arrange 
ment results in his own reports being processed again 
in the office of the Director of Indigenous Medicine 
which sometimes makes it difficult for him to take 
final decisions. The quest on ofrevising th : qualifica 
tion for animehod of recruitment to the post of 
Director of Indig -nous Medicine is under the conside 
ration of Government. It may take some time to issue 
final orders in the matter. 

(2 ) Considering all the above facts, the Government 
order that the Deputy Director of Indigenous Medi 
cine, ShiiM.S. a karanarayanan will hold full addi 
tional charge of the duties of the Director of Indige 
nous Medicine till a Director is appointed on a regular 
basis. He will exercise control only on the institu 
tions which were under the Director of Indigenous 
Medicine, i. c. before the two colleges were brought 
under the Director of Indigenous M - dicine. He will 
not have any cont ol over the two Ayurveda Colleges. 
Till a regular Director is app inted, the two Principals 
will be in charge of the respective colleges and they 
will correspo d d rect with the Government as before 
i. c .before the issue of G. O. Ms. 341/68 /HD . ted 
28-9-1968 . The Principals will also , as a temporary 
measure exer ise the powers that they were exercising 
before the issue of G. O.Ms. 341/68 /HD . dated 
28-9-1968. 

(3) This arrangement will be given effect to furth 
with and will be continued until the post of the 
Director of Indigenous Medicine is filled up on a 
regular basis . 

By order of the Governor, 

M.GOPAL MENON , 

Chief Secretary.

Dated, Trivandrum , 6th February 1970 . 
Whereas in exercise of the powers conferred by 
clause ( 1) of Article 258 of the Constitution , the 
President has in Notification No. 2/4 /63/ Judl. II 
dated 31-5-1963 entrusted the Government of Kerala , 
with their consent, the functions of the Central 
Government, under the Kerala Land Acquisition Act, 
1961 ( Act 21 of 1962), in relation to the acquisition 
of lands for the purpose of the Union, in the Kerala 
State ; 

And whereas it appears to the Government of 
Kerala that the lands specified in the schedule below are 
needed or are likely to be needed for a public purpose, 
to wit. for Doubling ofRailway track between Alwaye 
and Ernakulam notice to that effect is hereby given 
to all whom it may concein , in accordance with the 
provisions of Section 3 (1) ofthe said Act under sub 
section (4 ) of Section 19 of the said Act, the govern 
ment direct that in view of the urgency of the case the 
provisions of Section 5 of the Act shall not apply to 
this case.

Dated, Trivandrum, 6th February 1970. 
Wher as in exercise of the powers conferred by 
clause (1) of Article 258 of the Con - titution , the 
Prezident bas in notification No.2-4-1963 Judl. II dated 
31-5 1963 entrusted the Government of Kerala with 
their consent the functions of the Central Government 
under the Kerala Land Acquisition Act, 1961 (Act 21 
of 1962), in relation to the acquisition of land for thie 
purpose of the Union, in the Kerala State . 

And where s it appears to the Government of 
Kerala that the land specified in the schedule below is 
needed or is likely to be needed for a public purpose 
to wit for Doubling of Railway track between Alway 
and Ernakula.. , notice to that effect is hereby given to 
all whom it may concern , in accordance with the pro 
visions of Section 3 (1 ) of the said Act under Sub 
Section ( ) of Section 19 of the said Act, the Govern . 
ment direct that in view of the urgency of the case the 
provisions of Section 5 of the Act shall not apply to 
this case. 

രണഘടന 258 -ാം വകുപ്പ് (1 ) -ാം ഖണ്ഡ താൽ 
നൽകപ്പെട്ട അധികാരങ്ങൾ വിനിയോഗിച്ച് രാഷ്ട്രപതി 
യൂണിയന്റെ ആവശ്യങ്ങൾക്കുമായി കേരള സംസ്ഥാന 
ഭൂമി വിലയെടുക്കുന്നതു സംബന്ധിച്ചിടത്തോളം 1961 - ലെ 
കേരള സ്ഥലമെടുപ്പ് ആക "(1962- ലെ 21 -ാം ആക്റ്) 
പ്രകാരം 2 ക ന്ദ്ര ഗ വ ച ഞ ൻ റ ി ക ൻ പ്രവത്തിക 
31-5-1963 -ാം തീയതിയിലെ 2-4-63 Judl. II-ാം നമ്പർ 
പരസ്യപ്രകാരം കേരള ഗവണ്മെൻറിനെ ആ ഗവ 
ൻറിന്റെ സമ്മതത്തോടുകൂടി മരമേല്പിച്ചിരിക്കയാലും, 

താഴെ കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന പട്ടികയിൽ വിവരിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള 
ഭൂമി ഒരു പൊതുക്കാര്യത്തിനും അതായതു് എറണാകുളം 
ആലുവാ റെയിൽവേ ലൈൻ ഇരട്ടിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിനും ആവശ്യ 
മുണ്ട ന്നാ , ആവശ്യമുണ്ടാകാനിടയുണ്ടെന്നോ കേരള ഗവ 

ണ്മെൻറിനു തോന്നുന്നതിനാലും, അതിനുള്ള നോട്ടീസ 
അതു സംബന്ധിക്കുന്ന എല്ലാവകം മേപ്പടി ആക്റ്റ് 3 (1) 
എന്ന വകുപ്പിലെ വ്യവസ്ഥകളനുസരിച്ച് ഇതിനാൽ നൽകി 
യിരിക്കുന്നു മേല്പടി ആക°on 19 (4) എന്ന വകുപ്പ്

SUPPLY OF CATTLE -FEED - FEED MIXTURE 1970-71. 

Sealed competitive quotations are invited for the 
supply of cattle feed mixture to the Artificial In - emini 
tion Centres at Sherthalai, Alleppey and Pullad and 
Veterinary Dispensaries atMallappally Pulikeezhu and 
7helliyoor and Veterinary Hospital, Mavelikara for 
the per od from 1-4-1970 to 31-3-1971 as per the indent 
Naced from time to time by the Officers -in -charge of 
the respective institutions. The quotation should 
specify rate per Kg. of each item and composition 
of the feed . Quantity prescribed as ration for breeding 
bulls should also be specific d . 

Quotations should be affixed with Court Fee stamp 
worth Rs. 2 50 and should be accompanied by R. D. 
Chalın for Rs. 50 being the Earnest Money Diposit. 


The quotation with the superscription " quotation for 
supply ofmixed feed " should reach the uedersigned 
on or before 20-2-1970 at 4 p . m . and they will be 
opened on the sameday at 4.30 p . m by the under 
signed . 

All the conditions, rules and regulations of ender 
notices wil apply in this case also and the undersigned 
reserves the right to accept or to reject any quotation 
without assigning any reason and that his decision will 
be final and legally binding. Further details can be 
had from the above mentioned institutions or from this 
office at any office hours on any working day.

NOTIFICATION FOR LEASE IN 

PUBLIC AUCTION 
No. LA B. 376,62 / F 

6th January 1970 . 
The right of holding the lands specified in the 
Schedule below , on lease, for cultivating cardamom 
for a period of 20 years will be sold in public auction 
by the Assistant Settlement Officer, Kumily or by any 
other officer authorised by him subject to the following 
conditions and restrictions: -- 

1. The auction will be conducted at the P.W.D. 
camp shed Santhanpara . 

2. The auction will commerce at 11 
a , D. & In 
10th March 1970 , 

3. The upset price towards premium will be Rs. 50 
per acie . 

4. Every intending bidder shall before the auction 
con mences, deposit with the officer conducting the 
auction a sum of Rs. 10 per acre as carnest money. 

5. Each survey number or sub -division number will 
be auctioned separately. 

6. (a ) The lease will be granted in the name of 
the highest bidder provided the maximum extent leased 
in auction to a single person or jointly to more than 
one person shall not exceed 25 acre and provided the 
extent so leased together with the extents of cardamom 
lands by way of registry or lease, current or time-cxpired 
already helá jointly and severally shall not exceed 60 
acres. Provided further that the maximum extent of 
25 acres shall be reduced to the extent of cardamom 
land that the person has obtained by the lease of 
encroached areas or by the release of time expired leases 
or by both . In the case of cases of lands jointly to 
more than one person the area limits are the same as 
those for individuals and the joint owners shall be 
jointly and severally responsible for the rights and 
obligations affecting individual lessces. 

(b ) In the case of Firms and Companies the 
maximum extent that may be leased shall be as many 
multiples of the extent permissible for individuals as 
there are partners in the Firm or Company subject to 
a total extent of 100 acres ; provided that the extent so 
leased together with the extent of cardamom lands by 
way of registry or lease already held by the Firm of 
Company shall not exceed 300 acres. 

7. The person declared to be the highest bidder 
shall immediately after such declaration , deposit with 
the officer conducting the auction , an amount (inclusive 
of the earnest inoney already deposited by him ) equiva 
lent to 20 per cent of the total bid amount and in 
default ofsuch deposit, the auction shall be cancelled 
and the land put up for reauction on a future date. 
The earnest money deposited by the defaulter will be 
forfeited to Government immediately on such default . 
The earnest money deposited by the other bidders shall 
be returned to thein soon after the auction is over . 

8. The balance of the bid amount shall be paid by 
the bidder before the expiry of thirty days from the 
date of receipt of notice intimating confirmations of 
the lease or if the 30th day from the date of receipt 
happens to be a Sunday or other holiday on the next 
working day. The Assistant Settlement Officer/Special 
Officer may, however, for sufficient reasons to be 
recorded in writing extend the time for the payment 
for a further period or periods not exceeding 30 days 
in all.

with the foregoing conditions. 

(20 ) The lessee shall be answerable to the 
Government for all or any injury or damage done 
to the land and other Government property thereon 
cxceptas is permitted by the foregoing conditions. 

(21) The Government may revoke the lease 
wholly or in part, if any the dues payable to

(22 ) Iffthe amounts payable to Government or 
any part thereof together with interest or if any other 
amount due from the lessce are in arrears the same 
shall be recovered as arrears of land revenue under the 
provisions of theRevenue Recovery Act in force . 

(23) The lease may be revoked by the assign 
ing authority after giving sixty days notice in writing 
and by the Government or Board of Revenue without 
notice in an emergency , the Government or Board of 
Revenue being the sole judge of the emergency. The 
Jessee shall not in the case of such revocation or 
termination be entitled to any compensation in respect 
of any improvements effected by the lessee on the land 
or for the loss caused by the interruption of his 
nccupation . 

(24 ) In the event of terinination of the lease 
uilder condition (21) or (23 ) the Government shall 
be at liberty to levy proportionate pattom upto the 
date of such termination .

time arise between the Government or their officers on

rights, diities or liabilities of either party in respect of 
any matter or thing relating to or arising out of the 
lease or the construction or themeaning of all or any

or difference shall be referred for settlement by arbitra

Whereas I am satisfied after making necessary 
enquiries that the Execution of the Minor Irrigation 
work of constructing an Irrigation well in Sy. No. 
497/5 in Manjallur Panchayat, Minjallur Village, 
Thodupuzha Taluk should be executed in the interest 
of the Majority of the proprietors of the neighbouring 
lands. 

Now therefore in exercise of powers conferred by 
sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the T. C. Irrigation 
Act 1956 (Travancore-Cochin Act 1 of 1956) ait 
abstract of the estimate and the specification of the 
lands likely to be benefited appended herewith in the 
schedule below is published as required under the said 
sub -section . Notice is hereby given to all concerned 
persons who may have any objection to the said work 
being executed to put in their objections before the 
Collector, Ernakulam within fifteen days from the 
date of publication of this notification in the Gazette . 
or from the date of serving the notice upon the pro 
prietors concerned , whichever is later.

(1) Every one bidding at the sale should state 
whether he bids on his own account or as an agent, 
and in the latter case , should deposit a written 
authority signed by the principal, otherwise his bid 
will be rejected . 

(2 ) The selling oflicer, either on grounds of doubt 
ful solvency or other reasons recorded by him in 
writing may at his discretion disqualify a bidder from 
bidding at the sale . 

(3) Every intending bidder shall deposit with 
the selling Officer Rs . 25 as earnest money before the 
commencement of the sale . The sale is subject to 
confirmation by the Collector. The Collector also 
eserves the power of cancelling the sale or accepting 

bid other than the highest without assigning any 
reasons. The deposits of unsuccessful bidders will 
be refunded at the close of the sale . 

(4) The successful bidder shall,immediately after 
che sale, deposit not less than one- fourth of the purchase 
noney and pay the balance within a fort 
night from the date of his receipt of the order 
of confirmation . The caruiest money paid under clause 
(3 ) will be adjusted towards the balance of the purchase 
money or the last instalment thereof, as the case 
may be. 
In default of 

the due payment of any 
portion of the purchase money, the trees may be resold 
by the selling officer at the expense and risk of the 
purchaser, the moneys already paid by the purchaser 
being also liable to forfeiture. 

(5 ) The purchaser shall not cut or remove the 
trees unless and until the sale has been confirmed and 
the full amount paid , but shall cut and remove them 
within 2 weeks thereafter If the trees are 
not cut and removed within the time allowed , they 
may be resold by the Selling Officer at the expense and 
risk of the purchaser ; the moneys paid by the 
purchaser : being also liable to forfeiturer. 
Note :-- (i) In assignment cases in which the 

applicant himself is the auction pur 
chajer it is not necessary to insist on 
the cutting and removal of the trees 
unless for specialreasons (eg .) in lands 
close to the fore-shore of tanks, their 

removal is considered desirable. 
(ii) The timeallowed for the removal of 

the trees may be extended in 
discretion of the confirming authority , 
but he shall not be bound so to extend 

it. 
(6 ) \Videre the Selling Officer orders a resale of 
the trees under clause (4 ) or clause (5 ), notice of the 
resale shall be given to the purchaser and he shall not, 
after the receipt of such notice , cutor remove the trees . 
Any loss resulting from the resale,with interest thereon 
at 12 % per annum will be realised from the 
purchaser as if it were an arrear of land revenue, but 
in no circumstances will the purchaser be entitled to 
the profit, if any, accruing at the resale 
Note :-(i) Instead of reselling the trees under 

clause ( 4 ) or clause (5), the selling 
officer may, in his discretion recover as 
if it were an arrear of land revenue, the 
purchase money or any portion there 
of,which is due from the purchaser .

this notification shall be he d to be a valid notice to

said Act, all the registered holders are hereby required .

or removing any trees jungle, fences 
standing crops or other material obstruc 
tions, the bounr aries or other lines, the 
clearance of which may be necessary for 

the purposes of survey ; and

be required by furnishing flag holders 

and chainmeni and

survey as may be ceman led under the

പരും നരിട്ടോ, അധികൃത ഏജൻറുമുലാമാ താഴെ പം 
യുന്ന തീയതിയിലും സ്ഥാപിച്ചതും സമയത്തും ഹാജരാക്കയും, 
ഭൂമിയിൽ അവരോരോരു കാമുള്ള അവകാശബന്ധങ്ങളുടെ 
സ്വഭാവവും ഭൂമിയിൽ അങ്ങനെയുള്ള അവകാശബന്ധങ്ങൾ 
സംബന്ധിച്ചിടത്തോളം നഷ്ടപ്രതിഫലത്തിനും അവർക്കുള്ള 
തേർച്ചയുടെ തുകയും , വിവരങ്ങളും ആക്റ ° 8 -ാം വകുപ്പ 
പ്രകാരം എടുത്തിട്ടുള്ള അളവു സംബന്ധിച്ചു വല്ല ആക്ഷേ 
പവുമുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ , അതും ഏതാണെന്നു കാണിച്ചുകൊണ്ട് 
പ്രസ്താവന ചെയ്യുകയും അവരോ അവരുടെ, ഏജൻറുമാരേം 
എഴുതി ഒപ്പിട്ട ഒരു സ്റ്റേററുമെൻറ്റ് സമർപ്പിക്കുകയുംചെയ്യണ 
ാനും അവരോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു.

22nd January 1970. 
The Kollengode Harijan Agricultural Credit 
Society Ltd., No. HW . 3 was registered on 10-3-1961 
and started functioning on 21-3-1961. As the affairs 
of the society were not satisfactory an enquiry under 
Section 38 of the Madras Co-operative Societies Act 
VI of 1932 was held into the affairs of the society . 
The enquiry revealed that the society has ceased to 
function for over five years . 

No records or books of Accounts of the society are 
available. It is reported by the committee members 
of the society that all the records and Books of accounts 
of the society were destroyed by the President Sri 
A. Velayudhan , S/o . Arumughan and he committed 
suicide. 

The financial position ofthe society is also not 
clearly known. The society was given a working 
capital of Rs. 5,000 froin the Harijan Welfare Depart 
ment on 30-3-1961. This was deposited in a special 
savings bank account with the Palghat Co-operative 
Central Bank. Out of this, Rs. 1,485 was withdrawn 
during 1961 itself, but the details of utilisation are not 
available The balance of the grant with interest 
accrued there. n (total Rs. 4608.43) was refunded to 
Government on 12-6-1969 as there was no possibility 
for utilising the amout. Now the society has no assets. 
As such the society cannot be revived . In the circum 
stances I feel thatno useful purpose will be served by 
keeping this society on the rolls. I therefore hereby 
order that the affairs ofthe Kollengode Harijan Co 
cperative Society Lid ., No. HW 3 be wound tip under 
section 71 (1) of the Kerala Co-operative Societies Act 
1969 . Under Section 72 (1) of the same Act the 
Inspector of Co-operative Societies-Adan. Unit, 
Kollengode is appoinied as its Liquidator.

Section 38 of the Madras Co -operative Societies Act

Society. The enquiry revealed that the society was 
completely dormant from 1-12-1964 and that there is 
To scope for its revival. There were 74 members on 
the rolls of the society with a paid up Share Capital 
of Rs. 362 02. 

2. The past history of the working of the society 
is not known as the records of the society were 
destroyed either by the white ants or misplaced by 
the office bearers ofthe society . The Society did not 
undertake any appreciable work after 10-12-1964. 
The loans issued in the past have become timebarred 
and no action was taken for the recovery of such 
loans. 

3. From this itis clear thatthe society has completely 
failed to achieve the objects for which it was registered. 
In the special General body meeting convened on 
29-9-1966 with the aim of reviving the working of 
the society wasattended by only seven members and 
they resolved for voluntary liquidation of the society.

of Co-operative Societies, Cannanore recommended

agreed to the proposal. "Accordingly a registered notice 
was served to the President 

of the society on

to the notice no suggestion has been put- forth for the 
revival of the society . During the year 68-69 the 
society effected Collection to the extent of Rs. 213.37 
and issued a Medium Term loan of Rs. 300. This 
meagre transaction does not justify its continued 
existence. I have cosidered all aspects and came to 
the conclusion that the society cannot function success

5th February 1970. 
An enquiry was conducted under Section 65 of 
the Kerala Co-operative Societies Act, 1969 (Act XXI 
of 1959) into the affairs of the Tholassery Poultry 
Breeders Co -operative Society Ltd., No. A.174, The 
enquiry revealed the following . 

The Tholassery Poultry Breeders Co-operative 
Society Lid . No. A , 174 was registered on 6-3-1963 
and it started work on 17-3-1963. The objects of the 
society are to grow gooi varieties of chicken , ducks 
etc. to collect their eggs, sell them profitably and to 
distribute the sale proceeds to the members, issue of 
loans for the above purpose and the purchase and 
distribution of the poultry feed . 

As per byelaw 19 , the term ofoffice of the present 
committee is over by 27.4.1968. New Committee has 
not been elected so far. 

The society is dormant since 1967-68 . The 
members are not interested in the working of the 
society . The primary object of the socicty was neglect 
ed. It has no office, name board or paid empolyees. 

The Circle Officer, has issued notice under section 
65 of the Kerala Co -operative Societies Act on 
24-9-1969 to convenc the general-body within 15 days 
so as to ascertain its views. But the General-body has 
not met. 

In the audit report 1966-1967 it has been recom . 
mended to wind up the affairs of the society. The 
enquiry officer has requested to take steps to liquidate 
the socicty as their is no chance for its revival and 
there is possibility of the records being destroyed . 

The District Co -operative Bank has no objection in 
winding up of theaffairs of the society . The socicty 
has not taken up activities to promote the objects of 
the society as contemplated in the byclaws. A notice 
Was issued to the President of the society on 22-12-69 
requesting him to file objections if any within 15 days 
against the action of winding up of the affairs of the 
society . He has received it on 6-1-1970 . But no 
objection has been received till date .

സംഘത്തിന്റെ മുകളിൽ കാണിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന വരവുചെലവു കണക്കിൽ ഈടാകാൻ നിവ ത്തിയില്ലാത്ത മുതലുകൾ 
തളിയതായും കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതല്ലാത്തതായ ബാദ്ധ്യതകൾ തള്ളപ്പെട്ടതായും രേഖപ്പെടുത്തിയിട്ട് കൊല്ലം സഹകരണ 
സംഘം ഡെപ്യൂട്ടിരജിസ്ട്രാരുടെ അനുവാദപ്രകാരമാണ്. 

സംഘത്തിന്റെ നിയമാനുസൃതം അവസാന പൊതുയോഗം 30-9-1989 - ൽ നടത്തുന്നതിനു അംഗങ്ങൾക്കും നോട്ടീസ 
അയയ്ക്കുകയുണ്ടായി 

പൊതുയോഗത്തിൽ നാല് അംഗങ്ങൾ ഹാജരായി. ലിക്വിഡേഷൻ വരവു ചെലവ കണക്കുകൾ ഏക 
കണ്ഠമായി പൊതുയോഗം പാസ്സാക്കി. 

30-9-1969 - ലെ 341 63 -ാം നമ്പർഉത്തരവ് 
മുകളിൽ പ്രസ്താവിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള വസ്തുതകളുടേയും വിവരണങ്ങളുടെയും വെളിച്ചത്തിൽ ലിക്വിഡേഷനിലിരിക്കുന്ന 192-9 . 
നമ്പർ അഗസ്ത്യകോട് സഹകരണസംഘത്തിന്റെ ലിക്വിഡേഷൻ നടപടികൾ ഇതിനാൽ അവസാനിച്ചതായി പ്രഖ്യാപിക്ക 
പ്പെടുകയും 1989- ലെ 21-ാം നമ്പർ ആക്ററായ കേരള സഹകരണസംഘം ആക്ററിലെ 74-ാം വകുപ്പനുസരിച്ച് ഈ സംഘ 
ഞിൻറ രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ റ8 , ചെയ്യുന്നതിനും കൊല്ലം സഹകരണസംഘം ഡെപ്യൂട്ടി രജിസ്ട്രാരോട് ശുപാർശ ചെയ്യുകയും 
ചെയ്യുന്നു.

TRIVANDRUM DIVISION 


AUCTION SALE NOTIFICATION 
No. TC. 12766/68. 

29th January 1970. 
It is hereby notified for the information of the public that the 
right of collection and removal of tree growth from the under 
noted area will be sold in public auction on lumpsum basis at 3p.m. 
on 24-2-1970 by the Divisional Forest Officer, Trivandrum or any 
other officer authorised by him at the Divisional Forest Office, 
Trivandrum . If the day fixed for the sale happens to be a holiday 
the auction will be conducted on the next working day at the 
notified time and place. 

2. No charcoal burning will be allowed. 

3. Intending bidder should deposit an earnest money of 
Rs. 500 (Five hundred ) only in cash before the commencement 
of the auction without which nobody will be allowed to bid . 

4. The purchaser may inspect the area and satisfy themselves 
of the nature and distribution of tree growth , quantities available, 
facilities for work , transport and any other relevant matter before. 
hand. Complaints launched after the auction will not be enter 
tained 

5. The sale shall ordinarily be knocked down in the name 
of the highest bidder and confirmed by the competent authority 
provided that the character and financial status of the bidder is 
found satisfactory. But the Divisional Forest Officer reserves to 
himself the right to accept or reject any offer without assigning 
any reason therefor. The bidder shall not withdraw from his 
offer before receipt of final orders of the competent authority . 

6. On the date of auction, the successful bidder shall remit 
the full 1/3 value of the coupe or Rs. 10,000 whichever is less in 
cluding the earnest money deposit failing which the carnest money 
deposited by him will be confiscated and the rightresold at his risk 
and loss but he shall have no claim over the gain if any, resulting 
from the reauction . 

7. Within fifteen days from date of intimation of confir 
mnation of the sale, the purchaser should remit the balance 1/3 
valuc, if any as well as security calculated at ten per cent of the 


total value ofthe contract and the sales tax on the total bid amount 
as per the existing rules and execute an agreement on stamp paper 
worth Rs. three. If this is not done he shall be given a further 
fitteen days time to do so by the Divisional Forest Officer, subject 
to paynent of penal interest at twelve per cent per annum for 
belated remittance . If the default be only to execute the agree 
ment the purchaser shall be fined Rs. 20 by the Divisional Forest 
Officer , at his discretion as the case may warrant. Any extension 
beyond the fifteen days for the above will be decided by the Conser . 
vator of Forests, Quilon Circle, whose decision shall be final and 
binding upon the bidder. 

8. Failure to remit all dues and execute the agreement as 
above within any period thus extended will entail cancellation of 
the sale, forfeiture of all moneys remitted and resale of the coupe 
at the risk and loss of the purchaser. He shall have no claim for 
the gain if any by the resale. 

9. All the amount due to the Government from the purchaser 
either arising out of such resale or matters otherwise connected 
with the work will be recovered from him out of his assets if any, 
resting with the Department or as per provisions of the Revenue 
Recovery Act, by any legal means for the time being in force, 
if not paid within a time prescribed by the Divisional Forest Officer, 
Trivandrum . 

10. The balance 2/3 amount shall be remitied in two equal 
instalments, the first instalment within 15 days from the date of 
execution of agreementand the second instalmentwithin onemonth 
of the contract period whichever is carlier. Extension of time upto 
10 days for the remittance of the instalments shall however be grantel 
by the Divisional Forest Officer, subject to realisation of penal 
interest at twelve per centper annum . Any extension for periods 
beyond this will be decided by the Conservator of Forests, Quilon 
Circle on the merits of cach case and such decisions shall be final 
and binding on the purchaser. Failure to act up to the sale shall 
entail cancellation of contract subject to penalties provided for 
in conditions 7 and 8 above. 

11. In calculating penal interest for belated remittance of the 
security and balance value the period of less than a month and over 
15 days will be taken as one month and periods fitteen days and 
below will be reckoned as 1/2 a month . 


118 


KERALA GAZETTE

the contract whenever 


at Rs. 25 


12. Removal of produce shall be permitted only after remit 
tance of first instalments towards 2/3 balance value and removals 
thereafter shall be restricted to 1/3 of the money value of the con 
tract till the bidder pays up the second instalment. 

13. A draft copy of the agreement can be perused on any work 
ing days in the Divisional Forest Office at Trivandrum . Intending 
bidders are expected to get acquainted with the conditions of sale 
and agreement and satisfy themselves of the areas and growth 
thereon before participation in the sale. Complaint raised sub 
sequently will be rejected. The sale being conducted on lumpsum 
basis without reference to the extent of the area. The purchaser 
cannot question the extent of the area. 

14. The period of contract will be two months from the date 
of execution of Agreement. The entire quantity of timber and 
firewood obtainable from the coupeshould be collected and removed 
before the termination of the contract period . Ordinarily no ex 
tension of the period of contract will be allowed . In case any exten 
sion is granted the bidder is bound to pay penalty 
(Twenty five ) only per acre per month for the portion of the coupe 
five) per cubicmetre of timber, fifty (50 paise per2 cum . Fstacked 
firewood remaining unremoved at the close of the original contract 
period for each month during the extension period . 

15. All produces found uncollected or unremoved from the 
area at the expiry ofthecontract period or extension , if any granted 
shall be forfeited to Government. 

16. The purchaser shall see that the felling collection and 
removal of produce is done systematically and that it proceeds from 
one end of the area to the other strip by strip as directed by the 
Range Officer. No haphazard felling will be permitted . 

17. Seigniorage value of vakka drag rope calculated as one 
vakka drag rope for every two cubic metres of timber or fraction 
thereof and grazing fee for one elephant for very two cubic metres 
of timber or fraction thereof will be recovered on the actual quan 
tities collected . These amount shall be paid at the Range Office 
every time as and when pass is obtained , with sales tax due on 
vakka charges . 

18. The bidder shall have no relationship with any officer 
having control over the work and he shall not also be a supply 
contractor of this or any adjacent Division . He will have to give 
an undertaking to this effect which if proved untrue at any time 
shall result in cancellation of the contract at his risk and loss . 

19. The purchaser may be required to supply at the site not 
more than ten metric tonnes of firewood to Government institutions 
if directed by the Divisional Forest Officer at Rs. 8 (Eight) only 
per metric tonne stacked . 

20. If at any time during the contract period it appears to the 
Divisional Forest Officer that the purchaser is not doing the works 
satisfactorily or that he is not likely to complete the works within 
the time sanctioned the Divisional Forest Officer will be at liberty 
to cancel the contract after 14 days notice to the purchaser and 
resale the right at the risk and loss of the purchaser and all losses 
if any to Government shall be recovered from the purchaser in the 
manner provided elsewhere in the notice. The purchaser shall 
have no claim for gain if any on the resale . 

21. The purchaser shall be responsible for all damages caused 
to Government or private property and for all amounts becoming 
due to workmen engaged by under Workmen s Compensation Act 
or other labour laws. 

22. The purchaser shall at all times comply with the Forest 
Act and Rules framed thereunder and all circulars and other orders 
in the matter of the work. He shall be responsible for all illicit 
fellings and removals in the reserve, ifany within two furlongs of 
the coupe boundaries for all fires and subsequent damages or loss 
resulting as acts of carelessness on the part of himself or his emplo 
keep the boundary completely cleared ten feet wide and scraped 
well to act as a fire line also at all times . 

23. For any violation of the conditions of the agreement for 
which specífic penalties have been prescribed the purchaser 
shall be punished by the Conservator of Forests or by the Divisional 
Forest Officer with a fine not exceeding Rs.50 ( fifty) only or Rs. 20 
( Twenty ) only respectively at a time. 

24. The purchaser will have no right over the unremoved logs 
if any, lying collected in the concerned coupes for depot supply . 

25. Petitions or post offers received after the conduct of the 
sale will not ordinarily be considered . All intending bidders 
should be present in person . Authorisations unless under legally 
valid power of attorney will not be accepted . Such power of 
attorney shall be presented atleast 24 hoursbefore auction 


26. The contractor shall have his property mark registered 
or renewed as soon as he executes the agreement failing which he 
shall be fined suitably. 

27. The purchaser shall submit to the Divisional Forest Officer 
and the Range Officer a monthly statement before the fifth of the 
collected and removed explaining variations if any. He shay 
called upon to doso by the Divisional Forest Officer and theRange 
Officer, failing which he shall be punished with fine not exceeding 
Rs. 20 (Twenty) only for each default at the discretion of the Divi 
sional Forest Officer and a fine of Rs. 5 (Five ) for belated sub 
mission of the statements . 
- 28. The purchaser shall produce valid clearance certificate of 
income tax, sales tax and agricultural income tax from competent 
authorities before release of the security deposit. If any amount 
is due from the con actor on account of arrears if any, or all of the 
stalments as the Divisional Forest Officer may decide from the 
security deposit. 

29. The purchaser shall return to the Divisional Forest Office 
all stumps of bandyman pass books and unused permit books pur. 
chased for thework within thirty days from the date of expiry of 
the contract period failing which he shall be subject to penalty 
up to the forfeiture of security deposit. 

30. If any supplementary conditions are found necessary they 
will be published in the notice board of the Divisional Forest Office 
at Trivandrum before the prescribed time of the auction sale. 

31. On expiry of the contract all sums found due to Govern . 
ment from the contractor on account of this contract or in respect 
of any other contract with Governmentif not paid within the time 
specified by the Divisional Forest Officer, shall be recovered from 
the Security Deposit of this contract or any other contract entered 
into with the department. Any or all sums ofmoney due to Govern 
ment shall also be treated as arrears of public revenue due to Govern 
ment and shall be recovered from the contractor s other assets 
movable or immovable under the provisions of the Revenue 
Recovery Act for the time being in force. 

32. The Divisional Forest Officer can make any deviations in 
the above conditions if necessary at the time of the sale . 

Further particulars can be had from the Divisional Forest 
Office, Trivandrum and the Range Office concerned at any time 
during office hours.

2nd February 1970. 
Tenders are hereby invited for the execution of the following , 
maintenance works to be undertaken during 1969-70 in Kumali 
Erumeli and Ayyappancoil Ranges and Parampuzha and Vettikad 
Depots attached to Kottayam Forest Division subject to the follow 
ing conditions. Tenders should be separate for the whole works of 
cach institution and in scaled cover addressed to the Divisional 
Forest Officer , Kottayam superscribed as " Tender for the main 
tenance works of ............ Range or Depot" . Part tenders 
will be rejected. 

1. Each tender should be accompanied by a receipted chalan 
towards earnestmoney deposited in the District Treasury, Kottayam 
under Forest Deposit or Bank receipt withoutwhich no tender will 
be considered . 

2. Tenders should quote minimum rate required for each 
item of work separately (both in words and figures). The tender 
will be considered fum for acceptance for a period 3 of months from 
the date of opening of the tender . 

3. All works should be done in conformity with the approved 
specifications under the direct supervision and to the satisfaction 
of the Range or Depot Officers concerned before the 15th March 
1970. The details of works to be done can be had from the Divi 
sional Forest Oflicer, Kottayam . 

4. Tenders should reach the Divisional Forest Office, Kottayam 
before 3 p.m.on 23-2-1970 and they will be opened by the Divi 
sional Forest Officer or his deputy athis office at 3.15 p.m. on that 
date in the presence of such of the tenderers as may be present. if 
this day haj pens to be a public holiday, the tenders will be acce 
pted and opened on the next working day . The Divisional Forest 
Officer reserves to himself the right of accepting or rejecting any 
tender without assigning any reason therelor. 

5. In case the tenderer is a new one to this Department, he 
should produce the credentials in support of his financial status 
and previous experiepce in carrying out such works along with the 
tenders, 

6. The earnest money of the unsuccessful tenderer will be 
refunded after the disposal of the tenders. The successful tenderer 
should deposit an amount equal to ten per cent of the value of the 
contract in any of the Government Treasuries or approved Banks 
as security pledging the same to the Divisional Forest Officer 
and execute an agreement on stamp paper to the value of Rs. 3.00 
within 7 days from the date of communication of acceptance of 
the tender. 

7. Should the accepted tenders fail to act in accordance with 
the termslaid down in the aforesaid condition, the carnest money 
deposited by him will be forfeited to Government and he will be 
hcid responsible for the loss if any which the Government may 
sustain by making other arrangements for carrying out the works

EARNEST MONEY DEPOSITS 
2. (a ) Each intending bidder must deposit in cash 
or carrency notes only a sum of Rs. 500 (Rupees five 
hundred only ) as earnest money prior to the commence 
ment of the auction and also sign the sale notice in 
token of his acceptance of the conditions therein . 

b ) Earnest money deposit of unsuccessful bidders 
will be returned to them at the conclusion of the auction 
sale . 

( c ) Earnest money deposit of the successful 
(highest) bidder shall be retained . It will be liable for 
forteiture for any breach of the conditions of this 
auction sale by such bidder. 

( d ) No person shall be permitted to bid on behall 
of another unless he produces a valid Power of Attorney 
which is accepted by the officer conducting the sale . 
Such power of attorney must be on a stamp paper of 
the prescribed value and should be produced before com 
nancement of auction . 

e ) Immediately the sale is knocked down in the 
name of the highest bidder. he shall sign the auction 
register in acceptance of the entries made therein regard 
ing the bid . Failure to do so will not absolve him 
of the obligations in respect of the auction , 

(f) The officer conducting the sale reserves to 
himself the rights: 

(1) to accept or refuse the earnest money deposit 

offered by any bidder, without assigning any 

reason thereof; 
(ii ) to withhold from or add to the lots scheduled 

for the auction ; 
(iii) to debar any bidder or to send him out for 

the duration of the auction for any misconduct or 

misbehaviour affecting the sale ; and 
(iv ) The officer conducting the sale is at liberty to 

stop the auction at any stage, if he has renson 
to believe that the bidders have formed ring . 
and keen competition expected is not achieved due 

to any wilful actions of the bidders . 
Confirmation of the Sale 

3. ( a ) The sale is subject to confirmation by the 
competent authority, such authority reserving to itself 
the right of accepting or rejecting any bid without assign 
ing any reason therefor. 

( b ) All confirmation of sales will be intimated to 
the sticcessful bidders in the prescribed form with counter 
signed chalans for payment of balance value etc., by the 
Range Officer Teak Plantation Range, Parambikulam 
under certificate of posting or registered post as may 
be cieemed necessary. 
Measurement and classifications 

4. Departmental measurements and classification as 
per the stock registers of the Range Officer, Teak Planta 
tion Ronge, Parambikulam are final and must be accepted 
us inal and correct by all bidders. The department is 
not liable for shortage caused by dryage. 

5 Intending bidders are advised to inspect all the 
produce presented for sales and satisfy themselves about 
the quantity , measurements and species and also the 
quolity and condition of the produce thus presented 
Lefore con mencement of the sale . No complaints as to 
defects or difference in quantity, measurements, volume, 
species, vaine etc. etc., win be entertained under any 
circumstances after the sale has been knocked down , 
Government will not responsible for any damage caused 
by fire foods or any other cause to the produce sold , 
after the date of intimation of confirmations of the 
sile to the purchasers. 

6. Details of produce available for sale for this auction 
can be ascertained by intending bidders from the Range 
Oficer. Teak Plantation Range, Parambilulam . 


Removal at owner s cost 

7. ( a ) Purchasers shall be permitted to remove the 
produce bought by them from the sites of the Teak 
Plantation Range at their own cost, undercover of 
passes issued by the Range Officer, Parambikulam after 
payment of all amounts due to Government. 

( 5 ) In depots where departmental contractors are 
engaged for handling timber etc., the services of such 
contractors shall be utilised by the bidders for handling 
their timber etc., for which they will pay handiing 
charges as specified by the department. 
Defaulters prohibited 

8. No person who has been declared a defaulter at any 
previous auction held by the State Forest Department 
shall be permitted to bid at the sale either in person or 
through an agent even if the latter has been authorised 
by a duly executed Power of Attorney . 

9. (a ) Any money due from the bidder under any 
of the terms and conditions herein mentionerl in this 
notification shall be treated as arrears of land revenue 
and will be recovered under the provisions of the 
"Revenue Recovery Act in force as amended from time 
to time as if it were an arrear of land revenue or by 
any process which the Assistant Conservator of Forests 
or any other officer of the Government on behalf of the 
Government may deem fit to invoke. 

9. (b ) If a bidder defaults payment of any of the 
amounts under the terms herein mentioned , the release of 
the timber and other produce bid and fully paid for by 
him in the same Division or any other Forest Divisions in 
the State wil be withheld until the dues to Government 
are fully cleared. Government shall not be responsible 
for any loss which the defaulter may suffer as a conse 
quence, 
Payment of 13 Auction value 

10. (i) The successful bidder should pay on the spot 
one-third bid amount subject to a maximum of Rs. 5,000 
(Rupees Five thousand only ) less the earnest money depo 
sited , failing which the sale of the produce will be 
cancelled and the amount already deposited forfeited to 
Government and the produce resold at the risk and loss 
of the defaulting bidder as specified in conditions 13 (c ) 
and ( d ) below . 

(ii) If the total bid amount of the produce pur 
chased by a bidder is Rs. 500 (Rupees five hundred only ) 
or below , the full bid amount will be adjusted from the 
earnest money deposit at the conclusion of auction and 
balance, if any, returned. 
Payment of Balance value 

11. (a ) The balance purchase value shall be remitted 
by the bidder into any of the State Treasuries as per 
countersigned chalans issued , within 52 days (fifty-two) 
from the date of communication of the confirmation 
orders by the Range Officer, Teak Plantation Range. 
Parambikulam . Such balance value shall be remitted 
in one or more instalment as provided hereafter. 

(b ) If the last day fixed for remittance of balance 
value happens to be public holiday, the amount may be 
remitted on the next working day without penal interest. 

( c ) If the balance value is Rs. 20,000 or less than 
Rs. 20,000 the bidder will have to remit the same in one 
instalment, within the specified time of 52 days mentioned 
above. 

But if the balance value exceeds Rs. 20,000 the 
bidder will be allowed to remit the same in instalments 
as noted hereunder and will be allowed to remove the 
produce fully paid as per each instalment: 

(i) In case the balance value exceeds Rs. 20,000 
but does not exceed Rs. 40,000 in two instalments. 

(ii) In case the balance value exceeds Rs. 40,000 
but does not exceed Rs. 80,000 in four instalments . 

(iii) In case the balance value exceeds Rs. 60,000 
but does not exceed Rs. 80,000 in four instalments. 

(iv ). In case the balance value exceeds Rs. 80,000 
but does not exceed Rs. 1,00,000 in five instalments and 
so on progressively .

It is hereby notified for the information of the public that the 
right of collection and removalof the residual tree growth (except 
teak and Roscwood if any) over the undernoted area will be sold in 
auction at the Divisional Forest Oflice at Kovanad , on 2-3-1970 
at 3 p.m. under the usual conditions of sale on lump sum basis. 

2. The auction will be conducted by the Divisional Forest 
Ollicer, Malayattur, or any other officer authorised by him for the 
purpose and the intending bidders should deposit an earnest money 
of Rs. 1,000 for the coupe before the commencement of the auction , 

3. Subject to confirmation by the competent authority, the 
• highest bid will ordinarily be accepted but the Divisional Forest 

Ollicer reserves the right to reject any bid without assigning any 
reason therefor . The successful bidder should renit ininiediately 
after the auction , the full 1/3 value calculated at the bid knocked 
down or Rs. 10,000 whichever is less failing which the carnestmoney 
deposited will be forfeited to Government and the right resold at 
his risk and loss, but he shall have no claim over the gain if any 
which may accrue by such resair. The amounts due to Govern 
ment in the event of such resale will be recovered as per the pro 

of the Revenue Recovery Act. Within 15 days from the 
date of communication of confirmation of the auction the success. 
ful bidder should remit the balance 1/3 bid amount,ifany, the sale 
tax due thereon , the security equal to 10 per cent of the value of the 
contract and execute an agreementon a stamp paper to the value 
Rs.3.00 . A further period of 14 days may be granted for the 
remittance of the balance 1/3 bid amount, the sales tax and the 
security. No further time will be allowed . If the bidder remits 
all the dues in time and fails to execute the agreement a further 
period of 15 days more may however be allowed subject to the 
recovery of a penalty of Re. I per day. The balance value should 
be remitted in two instalments, the 1st within onemonth from date 
of execution of the agreement and 2nd within twomonths from the 
date of execution of the agreement. Extension of time up to 30 
days for the remittance of the balance 1/3 and 2/3 value shall 
however be granted by the Divisional Forest Officer, if it is within 
the contract period subject to the realisation of penal interest at 
12 per cent. For calculating interest, any overdue period below 
15 days will beignored and a period of 15 days and above but below 
one month will be treated as one month . Removal of the pro 
duce from the coupewill be permitted only after remittance of the 
1st instalment or the balance 2/3 value and removal will be res. 
tricted to 1/3 of the money value of the entire trec growth till the 
bidder pays of the last instalment. The conditions of the agree 
ment can be seen from the Divisional Forest Officers office, Mala 
yattur, Kodanad, and the intending bidders are expected to get 
acquainted with the said conditions and satisfy themselves of the 
area and growth thereon before participating in the auction .

Auction SALE Notice 
No Ci. 11141/69. 

29th January 1970 . 
It is hereby notified that the right of cutting, collection and 
removal of all timber and firewood from 2 Ayini trees standing 
in R.S. No. 87/1 of Dindimal Desom of Tavinhal Village in the 
plot assigned to one Sri K.M. Abdul Kader will be sold in 
public auction by the Range officer, Begur or by any other officer 
authorised on that behalf on 23-2-1970 at 3 pm at the Forest 
Range Office, Begur, subject to the following conditions. If the 
notified date happens to be a Government holiday the sale will be 
held on the next working day at the appointed time and place. 

CONDITIONS 
1. The bid will be made on lump sumn basis. Before being 
permitted to bid , the intending bidder should deposit with the officer 
conducting the sale an Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 50 (Rupees 
fifty only) in cash and sign a copy of the sale notice in token of 
having accepted all the conditions therein . 

2 The E.M.D. of the unsuccessful bidder will be returned 
immediately after the conclusion of the sale, on production of 
stamped receipt while thatof the successful bidder will be retained 
for adjustment towardsthe bid amount payable immediately after 
the sale. 

3. Immediately after the sale, the successful bidder should pay 
the full bid amount on the spot, failing which the E.M.D. already 
paid will be forfeited to Government and the trees resold . 

4. The sale is subject to confirmation by competent authority . 

5. The trees should be cutand removed within one month from 
the date of receipt of confirmation order on payment of Sales tax 
at current rate in force, 

6. The Divisional Forest Officer may at his discretion grant 
extension of time for cutting and removal of the trees on realisation 
of a penalty of Re. I per day of such extended period. 

7. If any permit is required for transport of the produce 
collected , the same should be obtained from the Range officer, 
Begur in accordance with the usual procedure. 

8. Further particulars regarding the sale can be had from the 
Range Officer, Begur.

to the society for rectification and the District Indus 
tries officer , Alleppey has reported that there is no 
scope for revival of the society under various reasons. 
In the above circumstance, the Committee members 
of the society, as per the Notice read as 7th paper 
above,were directed to show cause within 15 days, 
why action should not be taken for the winding up 
of the affairs of the society as per Section 71 of 


the Kerala Co-operative Societies Act 1969 (Act 21 
of 1969 ) The President and the Managing 
Committee of the above society were also informed 
that if no reply is received within the time limit 
fixed , it will be presumed that the President and the 
Managing Committee have no explanation to offer and 
that action will be pursued accordingly. The Coir 
Inspector, Thuravoor in his letter No. CS . 15/69 
dated 14-7-1969 addressed to the District Industries 
Officer, Alleppey has reported that the society is 
beyond revival and has recommended winding up of 
the affairs of the society under Section 71 of the 
Kerala Co-operative Societies Act 1969. The District 
Industries Officer, Alleppey as per his letter read as 
8th paper above has also recommended the proposal. 

ORDER 
In the circumstances stated and after studying the 
connected facts , it is found that no useful purpose 
will be served in keeping the Kadakkarappally Coir 
Vyavasay. Co-operative Society on the rolls for any 
further time. 

The affairs of theKadakkirapally Coir Vyavasaya 
Co-operative Society Ltd. No. 15 are therefore wound 
up 

under Section 71 of the Kerala Co-operative 
Societies Act 1969 (Act 21 of 1969). 

The Liquidation Inspector (Coir), Alleppey is 
hereby appointed as Liquidator under Section 72 of 
the Kerali Co-operative Societies Act 1969. He will 
immediately t.ke over charge of the affairs of the 
society and proceed to wind up the same after the 
expiry of the statutory period. He will recommend 
the cancellation of the registration as and when the 
affairs are finally wound up.

1. These Bye -laws shall be called the Entertainment 
Tax Bye-laws of Koothali Panchayat. 

2. These bye - laws shall come into force immeditely 
after the publication of the same in the Kerala 
Gover..ment Gazette. 

3. In these Bye-laws " Act" means the Kerala 
Local Authorities Entertainment Tax Act 1961 
(Act 20 of 1961), and the Panchayat means the 
Noothali Panchayat. Rules means, the rules passed 
under the Act. 

President means the President of the Koothali 
Panchayat and the Executive Authority means the 
Executive Officer, Koothali Panchayat. Pinchayat 
means the Koothali Panchayat and other expressions 
in these bye-laws shall have in the Act" , " Rules ! 
and the Kerala Pacchayat Act 1960 (Act 32 of 1960 )

Section 11 of the Act shall be strictly followed 

5._The Panchayat shall levy as per Section 3 of the 
Act, Tax at the rate of 10 % (Ten per cent) for all 
payments of admission to every entertainment per 
formed in th : Panchayat area , sa e these specifically 
exempted from payments of Tax under Section 7 (1) and 
Section 7 ( 3) of the Act. The due for the entertainment 
shallbe paid into the Panchayat Office before 11am 
on the next working day . In the case of cinema shows 
the Tax due for the shows shall be paid every Monday 
before 11 a . m . or on such days of the week as may be 
decided by the Executive Authority . 


6. Notwithstan ling anything contained in the bye . 
lawsNo. 5 above, the Panchayat may compound the 
tax payable in respect of any entertainment for a con 
solidated payment under Section of the Act in 
conformity with the rules 4 and 5 of Part 11 of le 
Kerda Local Authorities Entertainmeat Tax Rules 
1962. The consolidated payments of the t x shall be 
made in advance or in such instalments is may be 
decided by the Pachayat. The tax may ordinarily 
be compounded for a period of three months at the 
time for the amounts shall not be less than 75 % of the 
probable estimate of tax based on the actual receipt of 
the corresponding period immoliately before that for 
which tax is proposed to be compounded.

ment the gross sum received by him on account of all

culars such as (i) the name and address of whe

bye-law shall specify the period which and the restric 
tions , limitations and conditions subject to which the 
permission is granted and shall be signed by the Exe 
cutive Authority , 

11. Every order of the Executive Authority,refusing,

writing and shall state the grounds on which it 
proceeds 

12. When the permission is suspended or revoked or 
when the period for which it was granted has expired , 
the grantee shall be deemed to be without permission , 
until the order suspending or revoking the permission 
is cancelled or the permission is renewed .

SCHEDL LE 1 
Rul s under S ctions 3 , 9, 12 , 16 and 17 of the 
i anals and Public Ferries Act II of 1890 

RULES 
3. In this Act " Vessel" includes any ship , barge, 
boat, raft 

timber . ba uboos or floating materials 
p.opelled in any manner. 


" Channel" includes any water-way whether 
natural or artificial. 

" Line of Navigation " means, any navigable 
channel or series of connected navigable channels. 

" Canal" means a line of navigation declared to be 
subject to the provisions of this Act. 

" Ferry" means a place atwhich goods, animals or 
passengers are conveyed across a channel by means of 
vessels 

.. 

" Public Ferry" means a ferry declared to be 
subject to the provisions of this Act. 

9. From such date all previously existing rights of 
ferty within the limits defined in the notification hall 
cease and determine and it shall be unlawful for any 
person not duly authoried to convey goods, animals or 
rassengers by means of vessels across a channel within 
such litnits while such notification is in force. 

12. The Governor (in Council) or the managing 
authority shall appoint persons to collect tolls or fees 
payable under his Act. The collection of such tolls or 
of fees other than licence fees may under such condi 
tion as the Governor (in Council) may from timeto 
timeprescribe, be lea ed out, and in such case the 
lessee and his agents and servants shall be deemed to 
be so appointed . 

16. The Governor (in Council) may make rules in 
resprct of any canal or public ferry fur all or any of 
the following purposes 

(i) Declaring the powers to be exercised by any 
person employed under this Act ; 

(ii ) Providing for the grant of license for the 
inspektion of licensed vessels and for their maintenance 
in good condition ; 

(iii) regulating the dimensions and free board of 
vessels u ing a : y canal or public fe ry, the equipment 
of the same and the number of passengers and the 
nature and quan :ity of cargo to be carried therein ; 

(iv) regulatirg the speed at which vessels shall be 
moved, the passing f vessels , the light to be exhibited 
by vessels moving or at anchor, the working of licks, 
the moving of vessels and the use of landing places, 
wharls, pius, jerties, docks, basins, liebyes, sidings 
shed , or warehouses ; 

(v ) the disposal of vessels or other things confiscat 
ed or seized under this Act; 

(vi) for the convenience of passengers and 
generally for the purposes of this Act. 

17. Any person who breaks any rule made under 
this Act shall be punishable on conviction by a 
criminal court with fine not exceeding fifty rupees in 
one ca e of a single offence, and in cases f a continuing 
offence not exceeding ten rupees for every day during 
which such offe ices continued . If the offence is such as 
to endanger human ile, the punishment may exten ! to 
impri on uent of ei her descrition for one year or to a 
fine of Rs. 500 or both .

മന :പൂവ്വമായി വരുത്തിയ നാശത്താലോ ആവശ്യമായി 
പ്പെട്ട അസിസ്റ്റൻറ്റ് എഞ്ചിനീയരുടെ പക്കൽ കെട്ടിവയ്ക്കുണ്ട 

വരുന്ന കേടുപാടുകൾ തീർക്കുന്നതിനും ഉത്തരവാദിയായിരി 
താണു , 

ക്കുന്നതുമാകുന്നു. കുത്തക ക്കാരനോ അയാകൂടെ പണിക്കാമോ 
ക അകക്കാരൻ വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കമുള്ളപ്പോൾ ആളുകളെ ആ ചാപ്പകളിൽ താമസിക്കുവാൻ പാടില്ലാത്തതും ആ ചാപ്പ 
കടവുകടത്തി മറുകരയിൽ അപകടമില്ലാത്ത സ്ഥലത്ത് ഇറ കളെ നല്ല നിലയിൽതന്റെ പിൻഗാമി ക്കു ഏല്പിച്ചു കൊട 
ക്കേണ്ടതു . യാതൊരു കാരണത്തിന്മേലും നിണയിക്കപ്പെട്ട ക്കേണ്ടതുമാകുന്നു. കടവ ചാപ്പകളുള്ള സ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ അവ 
ഫീസിൽക്കവിഞ്ഞ ഒരു ഫീസ് വസൂലാക്കാൻ പാടില്ലാ യുടെരക്ഷായാവശ്യമായ കേടുപാടുകൾ മാത്രമേ ഡിപ്പാർട്ട 
അതുമാകുന്നു. 

മെൻറുകാർ തീക്കു കയുള്ള തട്ടികൾ മുതലായ മററു സൗകര്യ 
കടവിൽക്കൂടി കൊല്ലം മുഴുവനും തോണികൾ മാടി ങ്ങൾ ഏർപ്പെടുത്തിക്കൊടുക്കുന്ന പ്രവൃത്തി കടവു കുത്തക 
ന്നതിനാവശ്യമായ വിധത്തിൽ അതിമല ചളിയും മററും ക്കാരൻതന്റെ സ്വന്തം ചെലവി യോ ചെയ്യേതോകുന്നു. 
കത്തകക്കാരൻ തന്റെ സ്വന്തം ചെലവിയൽ നീക്കം കടവു ചാപ്പകളില്ലാത്ത സ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ ഡിപ്പാർട്ടുമെൻറിലെ 

കടവ 
ചെയ്യേണ്ടതാകുന്നു. 

കടമ്പായ പാറകൾ ഒരു ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥൻകടവു സ്ഥലത്തു തീർച്ചപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന ഒരു 
പ v (സലുകൾ , തപാതകസഞ്ചികൾ മുതലായവയം ക സ്ഥാന കുത്തകക്കാരൻ തോണികൾ സൂക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതും

അറിയിപ്പ് പലകകം പ്രദർശിപ്പിക്കേണ്ടതും അവിടെവച്ച 
ചുങ്കം പിരിക്കേണ്ടതുമാകുന്നു. 

കത്തകക്കാരൻ കടവിന്റെ രണ്ടിൽ ഏതെങ്കിലും ഒരു 
ഭാഗ ത്ത് കടവിലേക്കു എത്തിച്ചേരുവാനുള്ള റോഡിൽ പുഴ 
വി ൽ നിന്നും 30 അടി അകലെയായി തന്റെ സ്വന്തം 
ചെലവിന്മേൽ സൂര്യാസ്തമന. മൂതൽ സ , രോദയം വരെ 
വിളക്കുകൾ ഏർപ്പെടുത്തി വയ്ക്കുവാൻ ബാദ്ധ്യസ്ഥനായിരി 
ക്കുന്നതാണു്. വിളക്കും ഒരു അടയാള വിളക്കാകാവുന്ന 
താണു്. 

യാത്രക്കാരുടെകൂടെ കൊണ്ടുപോകുവാൻ അനുവദി 


ഒരു സമയത്തു 


ടാവുന്നതുംഅണ്ഡാകൃതിയിലുള്ളതുമായ ഒരു തുലാസ് കണക 
ക്കാരൻ സ്വന്തം ചെലവിൽ ഏർപ്പെടുത്തിവയ്ക്ക ണം . 
സാധനങ്ങൾ കൊളുമൂലം ആക്കാവുന്നതും തൂക്കം രജിസ്റ്റർ 
ചെയ്യാവുന്നതും ആകുന്നു. 

എക്സിക്യൂട്ടീവ്എഞ്ചിനീയരുടെ മുൻസമ്മതത്തോടുകൂടി 
യല്ലാതെ യാതൊരു വിധത്തിലും കകകാരൻ യാതൊരാ 
ളെയും കടവു സ്ഥലത്തു പ്രവൃത്തിക്കാക്കുവാൻ പാടില്ലാത്ത 
താകുന്നു. 

കത്തകക്കാരൻ ഇല്ലാത്തപ്പോൾ അയാളുടെ പ്രതിനിധി 
യായി എപ്പോഴും കടവു സ്ഥലത്തു മുക്ത്യാർ നാമപത്രത്താൽ 
അധികാരപ്പെടുത്തിയ ഒരു ഏജൻറാ ഏജൻന്മാരോ ഉണ്ടാ 
യിരിം ക ണ്ടതാൺ . ഏജൻറിന്റെ പേർ സം ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട 
സൂപ്പർവൈസർ മുഖാന്തിരം എക്സിക്യൂട്ടീവ് എഞ്ചിനീയരെ 
അറിയിക്കേണ്ടതും അയാൾക്കോ അവളോ അയയ്ക്കുന്ന വല്ല 
കല്പനയോ അറീയിപ്പോ കുത്തകക്കാരനു ബാധകമായിരി 
ക്കുന്നതുമാകുന്നു. കുത്തകക്കാരനോ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ അയാളുടെ 
ഏജൻറാ ഏജൻറുമാരോ അങ്ങനെയുള്ള കല്പനയോഅറി 
യിപ്പാ സ്വീകരിക്കാതിരിക്കുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ അതു കടവു ചാപ്പ 
യുള്ളിടത്തല്ലാം ആ ചാപ്പയുടെചുവരിന്മേലും ചാപ്പയില്ലാ 
ഞിടത്തെല്ലാം കടവ താണിയിലും ഒട്ടിച്ചു വയ്ക്കുന്നതും 
അങ്ങനെചെയ്താൽ അതു കഅകക്കാരൻറമേൽ മുറപ്രകാരം 
ടിയിരുന്നാലെന്നപോലെ അതേ പ്രാബല്യം അതിനു 


ണ്ടായിരിക്കുന്നതുമാണു്. P. W. D. എക്സിക്യൂട്ടീവ് എഞ്ചി 
നീയർ ആ മുക്ത്യാർ നാമത്തിനു അനുമതി നൽകിയതിനു 
ശേഷം മാത്രമേ ആ ഏജൻറിൻറയോ ഏജൻറുമാരുടെയോ 
നിയമനം പ്രബലമായി 

വരികയുള്ളു. നിയമിക്കപ്പെട്ട 
ഏജൻറാ ഏജൻറന്മാരോ അനുചിതമായിട്ടുള്ളവരാണെന്നു 
എക്സിക്യൂട്ടീവ് എഞ്ചിനീയർക്കും 

ത ാ സ ന ത ായാൽ

ണ്ടതും, തക്കതായ ഒരാളെ പകരം 

നിയമിച്ച മേല്പറഞ 
പ്രകാരം അറിയിക്കണ്ടതുമാകുന്നു. 

പ്രവേശനമാഗ്ഗങ്ങൾ വൃത്തിയായി വയ്ക്കുന്നതിനു കുത്തക 
ക്കാരൻ ഉത്തരവാദിയായിരിക്കുന്നതാണു 
ഒരു വാഹനത്തയുംഅതോടുകൂടി അ തിൽ കയറിയ ഭാര 

ത്തയും അതിലുള്ള മൃഗത്തെയും അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മൃഗങ്ങളേയും 
മാത്രമെ അയാൾ ജാങ്കറിലും പടികളിന്മേലും കൊണ 
പോകാവൂ . അയാൾ ജാങ്കറും പടികളുംഎപ്പോഴും ചാണകം 
വെള്ളം, അഴുക്കു മുതലായവയില്ലാതെ വൃത്തിയായിവയ്ക്കുകയും 
വേണം, 

യാത്രക്കാർ അഭിപ്രായങ്ങൾ വല്ലതും രേഖപ്പെടുത്തു 
വാനുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്യുന്നതിനായി എല്ലാ യാത്ര 
ക്കാക്കും സ്വതന്ത്ര്യമുണ്ടാകത്തക്കവണ്ണം കടാഗിൽ ഒരു അഭി 
പ്രായക്കുറിപ്പുപുസ്തകം കുത്തകക്കാരൻ വയ്യേണ്ടതും, അത് 
സ , പർവൈസറന്മാക്കും അസിസ്റ്റൻറ് എഞ്ചിനീയർമാക്കു . 
പരിശോധന നടത്തുന്ന അവസരങ്ങളിൽ കാണിച്ചുകൊടുക്കേ 
ണ്ടതുമാകുന്നു.

KERALA GAZETTE 


NOTIFICATION 
1. The annual subscription to the Kerala State Government Gazette falls due on the 1st January orlst July of 
every year and should be paid in advance on or before 20th of December or 20th of June every year so as to supply 
the Gázette from 1st January or 1st July as the case may be . 

2. Subscription will not be accepted for an uneven calendar full year or half year or for a shorter period than 
one half year. 

3. Subscription for full Gazette, Part I, Part I A , Part IB, Part II, Part IV and departmental sheets in Part III 
can be paid half-yearly and annually . 

4. Payments of subscription may be made either by cash or cheques drawn on Scheduled Bank or postalmoney 
order or original Treasury chalan . Postage stamps will not be accepted. Cheques from private parties will not also 
be accepted. 

5. Money order without full instructions relating to the period ofsubscription or the name of the Part of the 
departmental sheets for which subscription is paid, will notbe normally accepted and even if accepted the supply of 
the Gazette will commence only on the receipt of the relevant details. 

6. Late subscriptions also will be accepted . In such cases, back issues of the Gazette will not be supplied ; sub 
scription can be paid at any time of the year butwill be credited to account only for theyearbeginning from 1stJanuary 
cr 1st July orhalf year beginning from 1st January or 1st July. When subscription is sentlate the subscribers should 
specify the period for which the subscription is intended . 

7. Complaints regarding non -receiptof copies of the Gazette or any Part of the Gazette should be preferred to 
the Superintendent with thereference number printed on the address label of the respective subscriberswithin two 
weeks from the date of publication of the Gazette. Complaints received thereafter will not be considered . 

8. The address in which copies of the Gazette have to be sent should be written clearly in block letters . The 
name of the Post Office of delivery, the Zonal Number of the Post Office of delivery, if any and also the nameof the 
District in which the Post Office is situated should be included in the address in order to ensure prompt supply of 
Gazette to subscribers. 

9. Grant-in - aid Libraries of Kerala State as per list furnished by the Director of Public Instruction are eligible 
to get full Gazette at the concessional rate noted below and while paying the subscription at the concessional rate the 
register number of the Library with full address has to be furnished . 

10. Subscription at concessional rate will not be accepted for a period of less than one year. No concession will be 
allowed when such institutions subscribe for any one Part or Sheet of the Gazette. 

11. The Head of Account under which Gazette Subscription is to be remitted in the Treasury is XLIX (b ) and 
the chalan in original forwarded to the Superintendent of Government Presses for arranging supply of the Gazette 

Rates of subscription and advertisement charges in the Gazette 

from 1-1-1970 onwards will be as follows:

The holders ofthe prize-winning tickets in the State except I, II, III, IV , V & VI are requested to produce their 
tickets in person to the District Lottery Officers concerned . The holders of the prize-winning tickets of the I, II III, 
IV , V & VIare requested to produce their tickets to the Director of State Lotteries, Trivandrum -I, in person . Persons 
outside Kerala may send their prize -winning tickets to the Director of State Lotteries in the following address by Regis 
tered Post. In all cases oftickets surrendered ,the claimants should affix their signature on the reverse of the tickets 
with full address and accompanied by a stamped receipt for the prize money . All prize-winning tickets should be sur 
rendered within 60 days from the date of Draw . 

Personsresiding outside Kerala can get tickets (not less than 100 ) from the Lotteries Directorate, Trivandrum 
or from the Lottery Office , Kerala House, New Delhi. Postage, packing and forwarding charges at the rate of Rs. 2 
for the first 200 ticketsor part thereofand Ps.50 for every additional 100 tickets or part thereof, have to be paid along 
with the price oftickets less 20 % commission. Demands for not less than 5000 tickets will,however , be met at 
Governinent cost .

Trivand ,
